review_evidence: README identifies a Lean formalization of the classification of groups of order p*q for primes p and q.

The nine primary modules include the main classification results and supporting group-theoretic developments on torsion, cyclicity, prime-order groups, semidirect products, monoid homomorphisms, and multiplication on ZMod.
All current-primary files are direct mathematical content; no hard-exclusion invariant was established.
summary: Retain the full order-p-q group-classification formalization and supporting group theory.
